brain_proposals.name: eia.print_absorption_reversal
brain_proposals.rule: On an EIA-Thursday, take the print-window direction from flow_conviction per phase (sign(sflow)*sign(pxchg)) plus the absorption read, NOT the surprise sign or the D-1 trade tilt. Absorbed SELL under a flat/rising price through the print = crowded-short COVERING DISCHARGE -> UP; absorbed BUY under a falling price = buy-absorption FAILING -> DOWN; an ALIGNED final-phase flow (both same sign) wins outright in its own direction. Absorption is a SIGN FLIP against the absorbed side, never a damp-in-direction, and never a cap.
brain_proposals.scope: EIA-Thursday print days (D-lens); requires signed flow + price by phase (refine/live) - the blind gets the flow and infers against its own price forecast
brain_proposals.forward_evidence: G19: 0514 sell-absorbed-under-rising -> +590 UP (blind called -150 down); 0521 buy-absorbed-failing D-1 + aligned selldown -> -420 DOWN (blind called +280 up). Both blind misses were D-1-tilt-as-direction; the conviction read flipped both. n=2 same block, generalizes to any print-day absorption; consistent with structure.covering_absorption_directional_tell on non-print days.

brain_proposals.name: structure.covering_extension_crest_gate
brain_proposals.rule: A crowded-short covering tell flips from DISCHARGE-UP to DISTRIBUTION-DOWN once the covering rally reaches a maximally-extended crest: a new cum-from-anchor high, with the prior session topping at/near its OPEN and closing near its LOW under BUY-absorbed-under-falling flow. Past that crest, D-1 buy flow is DISTRIBUTION (up-leg over), not covering-with-room; do not read it as more covering.
brain_proposals.scope: mature multi-session covering rallies under an extreme COT short; the crest signature is open-time computable (cum-from-anchor extremity + prior-day top-at-open/close-at-low + buy-absorb-failing)
brain_proposals.forward_evidence: G19: covering ran to cum +3610 on 0519 (crest) -> 0520 seam break -1050 (top at open, close near low, +1892 buy absorbed under falling) -> 0521 continued DOWN -420; contrast the mid-rally 0513->0514 leg where covering still discharged UP +590. The gate is what separates the two same-COT prints. n=2 leg pair spanning the crest.

brain_proposals.name: positioning.cot_wow_covering_fuel_is_tail_not_p50
brain_proposals.rule: The covering discharge's SELF-LIMITING is gated on the COT MM-net WoW delta: WORSENING (shorts still adding) = squeeze fuel LIVE, self-limiting does NOT fire, retain a fat upper TAIL / re-ignition risk; FLAT-or-improving = spent fuel. But this gate governs the TAIL only - it NEVER sets the p50 sign. The p50 sign is always the target-day flow-vs-price conviction; an extreme+worsening COT short can sit under a p50-DOWN day.
brain_proposals.scope: crowded-short covering regimes (MM-net < ~12 1y-pctile); COT WoW delta + percentile are open-time
brain_proposals.forward_evidence: G19: both prints COT worsening (0514 WoW -10,244, pctile 2.83; 0521 WoW -12,576, pctile 0.94) yet delivered opposite p50 signs (+590 / -420). Fuel live on both; sign set by price both times. Prevents the S105 blind error of treating an extreme short as a standing p50-up bias. n=2; complements daytype.covering_giveback_self_limiting (which reverts the SECOND weekend-feeding day) by scoping the same fuel-gate to print days as a tail-only lever.
